observations.seen: A low warm sun sits right of the vanishing point and backlights the canyon in golden-hour tones. The orange-on-charcoal palette matches the recipe.
The tall buildings should throw long shadows across the road, but none are visible. The drones show no clear contact shadows, so they look like they float on the asphalt.
The wet road shows a bright specular streak under the sun. The building windows and the drones do not appear in it, so it reads as a highlight lobe rather than environment reflection.
The city is built from extruded boxes with tiled emissive window textures and a blocky arch gate. It has believable scale but little architectural detail or street-level dressing.
Distance haze softens the far towers and a warm glow spreads around the sun. The fog falloff sits roughly in the 30–180 m range.
The asphalt has some wet sheen. The barriers and buildings use flat diffuse materials, and the drone bodies are basic red and white shading with little roughness variation or wear.
The player drone is assembled from primitive cylinders and boxes. The rival on the left is a plain cylinder, and the rail barriers are simple beams.

The player drone sits right of center and fills roughly 8–10% of the frame, under the 15–25% target. The top menu bar and several HUD panels crowd the edges, and a centered crosshair competes with the subject.
The chase camera sits behind and above the drone with a horizon near mid-frame and an FOV that appears to be about 60°. The subject is offset and small.
Bloom on the sun and some vignette and grain are present. Grading is warm but somewhat muddy in the midtones, and the bloom halos look uniform rather than filmic.

The race HUD (position, lap, time, radar, speed, core temperature bars) is legible and stylistically consistent. It is cluttered by a persistent top bar of drone, track, and mode selector buttons and a control-hint strip, which together cover much of the frame.

nextChange.change: raise shadow strength toward the look target and pull the key light to an angle that throws visible contact shadows
